scenes.title: Thirty-Five Minutes
scenes.summary: Otavio panics over the double-booked room while Jorge unlocks the third-floor staircase.

scenes.title: The Sunny Attic
scenes.summary: Up in the quiet attic room, Camila, Jorge, and Bianca inspect the space and list what is missing.

scenes.title: Left at the Landing
scenes.summary: Camila, Bianca, and Otavio finish making the bed, plug in the warm lamp, and hear the front gate bell.

scenes.title: In from the Rain
scenes.summary: Quiet architect Rafael arrives soaked from the rain, and Camila and Bianca warm him up before explaining the room change.

scenes.title: Half Price and Quiet Beams
scenes.summary: Shown the cozy attic room at half price, Rafael admires the timber ceiling and happily takes the key.

scenes.title: A Five-Star Sigh of Relief
scenes.summary: Downstairs Otavio celebrates the solved double-booking until Camila spots a small leather notebook left on the counter.

scenes.title: Returning the Notebook
scenes.summary: Camila returns Rafael's leather notebook and hears the bathroom hot-water pipe clank and go lukewarm.

scenes.title: Ice-Cold Pipes
scenes.summary: Coming up from the cellar, Jorge delivers bad news: the hot-water boiler valve just cracked for the night.
